name: HiveMind
description: A shared room where a team of humans and a team of AI agents work on one goal together. Choose from nine multi-agent architectures.

skills.name: Auto team
skills.description: An Architect agent reads the goal and designs the team for it, choosing one of the eight patterns at runtime.

skills.name: Sequential team
skills.description: Specialists work in a fixed line. Each one’s output is the next one’s input.

skills.name: Router team
skills.description: A Router reads the request and hands it to the single best specialist. No planning, no merging.

skills.name: Orchestrator team
skills.description: An Orchestrator plans subtasks, delegates them to specialists, and combines the results.

skills.name: Hierarchical team
skills.description: A VP splits the goal into workstreams, Managers plan each one for Workers, and results roll back up.

skills.name: Parallel team
skills.description: A Planner draws a task graph with dependencies. Independent tasks run at the same time; a Synthesizer joins them.

skills.name: Fan-out / Fan-in team
skills.description: A Splitter fans the goal out to several personas who work in parallel; a Combiner merges what comes back.

skills.name: Peer-to-peer team
skills.description: Three equal peers debate in turns, each proposes an answer, and everyone (humans included) votes. The winner writes it up.

skills.name: Swarm team
skills.description: Five agents share a blackboard. Each turn they bid to speak, the highest bid wins, and the order emerges from the work itself.
